title: Gateway Update and Live Patch Commands

presets.name: List Live Patches
presets.description: Lists known Live Patches and their current status.

presets.name: List Live Patches on All Maestro Members
presets.description: Runs cplp list on all Maestro or Scalable Platform Security Group members. Use only for Maestro or Scalable Platform targets.

presets.name: Show Detailed Live Patch Status
presets.description: Shows detailed Live Patch and process status.

presets.name: Show Installed AutoUpdater Bundles
presets.description: Displays installed AutoUpdater bundles and take numbers.

presets.name: Show Urgent Security Update Information
presets.description: Filters cpinfo output for Urgent Security Update information.

presets.name: Check AutoUpdater Status
presets.description: Checks AutoUpdater connectivity, configured update interval, and last update check.

presets.name: Show Urgent Security Updates
presets.description: Shows current and previous Urgent Security Update packages.

presets.name: Show AutoUpdater Configuration
presets.description: Shows the current AutoUpdater configuration without changing it.

presets.name: Check for Urgent Security Updates Now
presets.description: Triggers an immediate check for available Urgent Security Updates.

presets.name: Configure Urgent Update Maintenance Window
presets.script: autoupdatercli enable_maintenance_window urgent_security_updates '{"hour":7,"minutes":30,"days_specification":"by day in week","day_of_week":["Thu"]}'
presets.description: Configures a maintenance window in which Urgent Security Updates can be downloaded and installed. Review and edit the schedule before running.

presets.name: Stop AutoUpdater
presets.description: Stops the AutoUpdater process. Use only for troubleshooting or offline installation work.

presets.name: Install Offline CPLP Package
presets.description: Installs an approved offline CPLP package. Replace the example path before running.

presets.name: Disable AutoUpdater Checks
presets.description: Sets the update-check interval to zero, which disables automatic update checks.

presets.name: Disable Urgent Security Updates
presets.description: Disables automatic Urgent Security Updates. Use only after security-risk review and Check Point guidance.

presets.name: Revert Live Patch Protection
presets.description: Reverts Live Patch protection. Use only with Check Point Support guidance and after confirming the required options.
